elements.text: Result of Election to the Coffee Board

In pursuance of the Motion adopted by the Rajya Sabha on 25th March, 2022, Shri N. Chandrasegharan, Member, Rajya Sabha has been duly elected on the 31st March, 2022 to be a member of the Coffee Board.

elements.text: Members' Lounge Facility in Parliament Library

runs.text: Members' Lounge Facility in Parliament Library

elements.text: Hon'ble Members are informed that the Lounge has been set up for holding their discussions and meetings where tea and snacks services will be provided by the ITDC. The Lounge has become functional in Parliament Library, PLB, Room No. G-052 w.e.f. 30.03.2022. Hon'ble Members are requested to avail the Members' Lounge facility in Parliament Library, PLB.
